items.title: Pay the City of Dover business license fee
items.authority: City of Dover Department of Planning and Inspections
items.description: Dover's code licenses trades, businesses and occupations operating in the city. A license runs from August 1 to July 31, and a penalty set in the code's fee schedule applies when the fee is not paid by August 31; the fee itself depends on the type of business (Chapter 26, Article II and Appendix F of the Dover Code).

items.title: Renew your Middletown business license
items.authority: Town of Middletown Permits, Licensing & Inspections
items.description: Every business located in Middletown, and every contractor working within the town, needs a town business license, renewed by February 15. The fee depends on the kind of business: $135 for a construction, retail-service, administrative, educational or one-or-two-person personal care business, $275 for professional, finance, health care or larger daycare businesses, and $5.50 per space for a mobile home park. Manufacturers, retailers, wholesalers and bottlers instead pay $0.00046 on gross receipts above $400,000, with a $135 minimum, or $50 if gross receipts are under $100,000 and the town gets a letter by February 15. Payments after February 15 pay a penalty of 1% a month and a $100 failure to file fee.

items.title: Obtain a City of Newark business license
items.description: A business license is required for businesses operating in the City of Newark, Delaware. Fees are set from estimates of the demand and cost of municipal services related to business activity, under Chapter 13, Article VII of the City Code (section 13-43 and following). The page read gives no amount or renewal date.

items.title: Get and renew a Smyrna business license
items.description: Any business that sells goods or services from a location in Smyrna must be licensed and registered before it opens, and licenses are for the calendar year. The 2026 fee schedule charges $125 per location for most businesses, $250 for each architect, attorney, accountant, dentist, physician, engineer and similar professional, for banks and loan agencies and for daycares over six children, and $125 for the first two barbers or beauticians. A business outside town limits that works in Smyrna needs a $125 contractor license, and a peddler or solicitor $125. The town's page does not give a renewal date.

items.title: Get a Smyrna rental license
items.description: A landlord who rents out property in Smyrna needs a rental license, which costs $100 in 2026, plus a $75 rental inspection and $100 for any re-inspection.

items.title: Obtain a City of Wilmington business license
items.authority: City of Wilmington Finance Department, Wage and Business License Division
items.description: Businesses operating within Wilmington need a Delaware state business license and also a city business license; the city application asks for a copy of the state license. Some trades (heating, plumbing, air conditioning) must pass a trade test with the Department of Licenses and Inspections first, and restaurants must supply a Board of Health certificate. The fee and renewal date were not stated on the pages read.
